requiredBeforeProvisioning: Explicit owner approval naming the disposable database and migrations 001–021
Confirm target does not already exist; refuse to overwrite or drop it
Use same local PostgreSQL server, new database only; no cluster/service/role changes
guard: Exact target name must match before every migration/test write; prevent DATABASE_URL/.env fallback to sirona
initialization: Existing migrations 001–021 only after approval; dedicated fresh target, no production data copy
testScope: Scoped standalone/project/auth/CSRF/ownership/lease/fault-injection tests; no paid-provider inference claimed
cleanup: Keep dedicated target for P1; no DROP without separate owner instruction
deferral: P0 can close with explicit owner deferral; integration tests remain unverified until approved provisioning
restore: P0 encrypted dump is not restored into working sirona; any restore uses a separately approved new database
approval: Owner Yes proceed following named P0 target/migrations request; no blanket protected-phase authority
